from collections import defaultdict

def stats(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]]
 fs=[lambda r,c:r,lambda r,c:c,lambda r,c:r+c,lambda r,c:r-c]
 ret=[]
 for f in fs:
  groups=defaultdict(list)
  for r,c,v in pts: groups[f(r,c)].append(v)
  good=[vs for vs in groups.values() if len(vs)>=2 and len(set(vs))==1]
  ret.append((sum(map(len,good)),len(good),sum(len(v) for v in groups.values() if len(v)>=2),len(groups)))
 return ret

def infer(g, key):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]]
 for p in range(1, max(h,w)*2+1):
  mp={}; ok=True
  for r,c,v in pts:
   k=key(r,c)%p
   if k in mp and mp[k]!=v: ok=False; break
   mp[k]=v
  if ok and len(mp)==p: return p,mp
 return None
print(infer(d1,lambda r,c:r-c)); print(infer(grid,lambda r,c:r+c))
